motivation: Gate B.0.3 adds a deterministic signed Trial B fixture that first completes a positive Workspace B read, then attempts a scoped symlink read to Workspace A. The prior signed fixture passed deep verification but omitted Hardened Runtime on the outer app and three XPC services; its embedded Python framework also contained ad-hoc native code that would fail library validation. This bounded experimental-builder fix signs Python native code and nested app/XPC bundles from the inside out with the same Apple Development identity and verifies every required CodeDirectory runtime flag. It does not change the production Seed builder or runtime.
invariants: Production Kernel, ABI, workspace scope, approval authority, production trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. The experimental fixture preserves existing entitlement files, enables Hardened Runtime without disabling library validation, and signs embedded Python code with the same development Team ID. The new fixture adds no Kernel or Launcher authority and does not modify the existing experimental trusted Launcher overlay. Result equality alone is not treated as replay; each result remains bound to its own runtime trial, request, approval, parent terminal, and DSH delivery.
authority_delta: 0 production Kernel authority, 0 Kernel ABI, 0 production workspace-scope authority, 0 production trusted-runtime delta, 0 production dependencies, 0 new trusted processes or IPC operations. Changes are limited to a test-only acceptance builder signature policy and regression tests.
real_os_tests: Historical evidence retained: source SHA d807f302b86e1ccf98049fece3226aa0b4c75561 built and deep-verified, but its launcher and three XPC CodeDirectories had flags=0x0(none); only DSH Node had flags=0x10000(runtime), so no picker or UI trial was started. The first compile attempt failed before signing on a missing Swift return; the bounded compile fix remains in the change. Current Hardened Runtime signer changes are covered by focused builder tests, but the fresh signed app and Trials A/B have not yet run. Earlier canonical suite, DSH semantic tests, bridge/lifecycle tests, and Security Freeze results are historical and do not validate this signer fix.
trusted_delta: Production trusted source delta is 0. Experimental signed behavior changes only through the existing test-only DSH acceptance bundle. Its builder now re-signs the embedded Python native runtime and preserves the existing per-bundle entitlements while requiring Hardened Runtime flags on the app, XPC services, and DSH Node. The deterministic AgentHost fixture still adds a positive Workspace B read before the cross-workspace symlink read, and the evidence evaluator binds the target to Trial A canary digest. No signed UI evidence is claimed until the new bundle and trials complete. Independent review remains pending.
baseline_decision: Bind the declaration to exact PR #48 base e27aed3ee3f40e7a008517ab7d8242bebe25a7c2 and the exact protected paths below. Refresh the focused acceptance-test digest in the reviewed manifest. Production Kernel authority, ABI, workspace scope, trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. Security Freeze is governance evidence; independent experimental behavior review remains pending. The previous app is not accepted for Gate B.0.3 because its app/XPC signatures lacked Hardened Runtime.
